svg.aria-label: output-styles/overdrive.md: Copy to ~/.claude/output-styles/, then select it under Output style in /config. statusline-command.sh: Point statusLine.command in ~/.claude/settings.json at it. Chips for tools you lack stay empty. hooks/overdrive-banner.sh: A SessionStart hook: the pink banner and the frame reminder. tools/overdrive/overdrive: Link into your PATH. It expects ~/.claude to be a local git repo
